name: GhostKode
tagline: Finds the most unstable lines in a codebase from Git history.

awards: [MLH] Best Use of Auth0 AI Agents

problem: Developers cannot see which lines keep breaking.
solution: Pulls blame and commit history and scores each line by semantic churn with embeddings, highlighting the 'ghosts'.
demo_moment: Team-described: summon ghosts on a file and see risky lines.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Auth0 AI Agents” among 223 submissions.

lessons: History reveals risk better than static analysis alone.
